d: Madar is a leading Saudi digital logistics platform, owned by Elm, transforming transportation management across industries. It connects shippers, carriers, and logistics partners through a unified ecosystem that delivers visibility, efficiency, and automation. Madar enables seamless shipment execution, financial integration, and real-time tracking, redefining the future of logistics in the Kingdom and beyond.

Madar is seeking an experienced Finance Manager to lead our financial operations. You will own financial planning, budgeting, reporting, and analysis, and provide insights that guide strategic decision-making. You will also continuously refine financial procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards, and partner with other departments to align resources with business goals. This role is central to the financial health of Madar and to supporting its next phase of growth.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
Fully certified CPA or CMA (completed certification; candidates with only coursework, training, or in-progress status will not be considered)

3–5 years of experience as a Finance Manager or in a comparable finance leadership role, with a proven track record of delivering financial performance; 10+ years of experience in finance management or accounting is strongly preferred
Proven experience in the Saudi market and in the logistics, transportation, or supply chain sector (experience in a digital logistics platform or comparable company is a strong advantage)
Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting
Solid understanding of financial regulations and accounting principles relevant to the logistics sector
Strong knowledge of ZATCA regulations and compliance requirements
Hands-on experience with VAT, excise tax, corporate income tax, and zakat filings in Saudi Arabia
Proficiency with ERP systems and financial software for accounting and reporting
Proven ability to manage and direct finance teams effectively
Ability to work with cross-functional teams across all organizational levels
Business fluency in both Arabic and English
Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
Based in Riyadh or able to work on-site in Riyadh
Previous experience at a logistics or transportation technology company
Experience working with Saudi regulators and external auditors

li

li

li
